source: lab (real recording, background replaced by green: segmentation-style compositing)

camera.motion: static (phase correlation vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.14 px in all frames)
camera.view: looks down obliquely at a wheeled over-bed table from its front; table top recedes upward in the image (far edge y~318-335, near edge y~477-495); no horizon visible (green replaced background)

ball.description: small orange/tan ball (looks like a light textured ball, ~25 px across at rest); the only moving object
ball.visible_frames: 0-46 (gone 47-48; leaves the bottom image edge after frame 46)
ball.reference_point: visible centre = mask bbox centre (cx, cy); centroid also given

apparent_size_px.falling_in_front_of_board_30_35: only the bright core is segmented (16-20 px wide) - underestimates
apparent_size_px.on_table_36_40: width 20-24 px (faint, blurred), vertical extent inflated by motion blur
apparent_size_px.below_table_41_45: width 28-32 px (horizontal width is the least blur-affected measure); height 34-57 px = blur streak
apparent_size_px.frame_46: partly cut by bottom image edge, width 25 px unreliable

white_board.description: white rectangular board/tablet leaning upright on the table top, near the back-centre; the ball rests on its top edge at the start

table_top.description: wooden (light brown) rectangular top of a wheeled over-bed table, seen in perspective

extents_px.edge_thickness: ~10 px (dark front strip y~495-505 at left, 477-487 at right)

table_stand.description: grey metal pedestal column under the table, with an upper cross-bar (casters at ~(563,537) and ~(696,560)) and a lower T/L base with casters at the bottom image edge (~(705,700))
table_stand.column: from table underside y~498 down to base y~680, x ~640-670 (lower part lighter grey)
table_stand.notes: base cut by the bottom image edge

events.event: ball at rest on top edge of white board
ball starts to move (release / rolls off the board top)
ball falls in front of the white board (faint over white)
ball hits the table top just in front of the board foot (bounce)
events.note: image downward step drops from ~29 px/frame (35->36) to ~9 px/frame (36->37); impact between 35 and 37, best 36

events.event: ball moves toward camera over the table top (bounce/roll)
ball passes the near (front) edge of the table
ball falls below the table toward the floor, accelerating
ball leaves the image at the bottom edge
